qualifiedClaims: The しょうじょう entry redirects to じょうしょう. The latter explicitly identifies しょうじょう as an older reading; frozen JMdict independently includes both full-word readings without a reading-specific historical flag.
The first sense is an ancient Chinese minister assisting the sovereign in state affairs, established from the Warring States period; the second is a Chinese-style title for 大臣.
The entry explicitly explains both characters through helping. The compound should not be explained as 丞 help plus 相 mutual, despite mutual being another ordinary sense of 相.
Use primary じょうしょう for the proposed new support identity, with しょうじょう as qualified historical recognition. This is a source-backed editorial choice, not a measured frequency ranking.
sources.limits: No unrestricted modern-cabinet synonym claim. No relative frequency measurement, invented everyday collocation, independently verified historical quotation, or constituent allocation of the older しょうじょう reading is established.
